skill_name: Summarize the article: "A survey of machine learning methods for rhetorical question identification"
workflow: This paper investigated the use of machine learning methods to identify rhetorical questions in documents. Specifically, two approaches were compared, a supervised method using an SVM classifier, and an unsupervised approach using a support vector algorithm and a clustering technique. The results found that both methods performed well in comparison to the existing state-of-the-art, with the supervised approach demonstrating the highest accuracy.
